why: The BDF/PCC is a named, study-developed multisource assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: Bahrain Defence Force Instrument for professionalism, communication, and collaboration (BDF/PCC)
product_description: A 39-item, five-point multisource feedback questionnaire developed by Strachan et al. to assess medical graduates' professionalism, communication, and collaboration through ratings from colleagues and coworkers.
